hook: *KRMB* meeting day: BRS says its water delegation was stopped
hook_b: *KRMB* meeting day: BRS says its water delegation was stopped
tldr: BRS says its leaders were placed under house arrest or stopped on Monday before they could submit a representation to the Krishna River Management Board on Nagarjuna Sagar water.

beats.what: The party says Sabitha Indra Reddy and MLC Dasoju Sravan were placed under house arrest and former MLA Kancherla Bhupal Reddy was stopped at Chityal.
beats.why: Nagarjuna Sagar storage is crucial for Hyderabad's drinking water, and the party cites the El Nino crisis.
beats.care: Nagarjuna Sagar feeds Hyderabad's drinking water, so its storage level matters for supply in the coming dry months.

causes.label: AP tunnel works near Nagarjuna Sagar

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Update: BRS says it planned only to submit a representation, not protest, and is demanding the DGP explain the police action.

cards.q: How worried are you about Hyderabad's water supply next summer?

qs: How much of Hyderabad's water comes from Nagarjuna Sagar this season?
What can KRMB do once a project is under way?

facts.t: Namasthe Telangana reported AP is digging a *₹1,200 crore* tunnel from Nagarjuna Sagar.
The paper says the tunnel could draw water even at the *510 ft* dead storage level.
AP sought *9 TMC ft* more from Nagarjuna Sagar over three months: 8 right canal, 1 left.

learn.t: KRMB = Krishna River Management Board, which oversees Krishna water sharing between Telangana and AP

watch: The KRMB three-member committee's decision on AP's request; it has deferred drinking water allocations several times.
